parameter_derivation.moisture_coordinate: W = y/(1-y), y = original percent wet basis/100

model_choices.interpolation: linear between two nominal measured nodes on the same 30% MIR preparation branch
model_choices.temperature_dependence: constant at given W across declared temperature domain; assumption because original measurement temperature and k(T) are unknown
model_choices.pressure_dependence: no pressure coordinate; no pressure-dependent constitutive response is supplied
model_choices.material_transfer: VIP faecal donor measurements applied conditionally to the Arlabosse wet-storage hybrid

exploration_domain.scope: nominal-coordinate interpolation only; source moisture uncertainty does not certify coverage of true node positions

numerical_policy: exact rational interpolation of printed source numbers and input values; float inputs and float domain endpoints mean represented binary64 values; final float projection reported separately

uncertainty_policy.source_confidence_intervals: preserve the two original 90% moisture/conductivity intervals without reinterpreting them as interpolated or cross-material bounds
